question: The region where all of the light from the source is blocked is called:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Umbra.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Umbra: The region of the complete shadow is called the umbra.**
 
• In a solar or lunar eclipse, the region of the earth's shadow is divided into three parts. The three parts are:
 
 
• **Penumbra: **The region of the diffuse shadow is called the penumbra.
 
• **Antumbra:** The antumbra is the lighter part of a shadow that forms at a certain distance from the object casting the shadow.
 
• **Umbra:** The region of the complete shadow is called the umbra.​
